· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 관망 조건: 지지선 재확인 및 거래량 동반 상승 확인
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($0.18) vs SMA5 ($0.18)/SMA20 ($0.20)/SMA50 ($0.23): testing short-term resistance, below mid-term trend.
· Below SMA100 ($0.21)/SMA200 ($0.21): indicating weak medium-to-long term trend.
· 52-week position (8.8%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (32.7→32.4) + sustained oversold condition + downward pressure persists.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0016→-0.0009) + improving trend + weak signal for trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (at lower band $0.17) + band width at 26.38% is normal.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level ($0.17) + based on lower BB, Pivot S1.
· Swing resistance level ($0.18) + potential for short-term bounce on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (not Higher Low, sideways) + weak trend reversal signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.40x) + low confidence in current price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + conditions for entry: reconfirmation of support and confirmation of rising volume.
